title: Wirsching's Positive-Predecessor-Density Program: Proofs of Conjectures 1 and 3
summary: Wirsching (2003) reduces uniform positive predecessor density for the $3n+1$ map to a chain of five conditions, organized into three conjectures. We prove two of them. Conjecture 1 concerns his path-counting generators: in the convolution carrying them to his Elka functions the partition weights grow subexponentially while the binomial ratio decays geometrically, so a window of width $O(\sqrt{\ell})$ dominates and its radius fits inside the hypothesis.
